name: File Manager Core Utility
description: Perform robust file operations: copy, move/rename, delete files or directories, create directories, check if a path exists, get file info, or find files by wildcard patterns inside the sandbox.

action.description: The file action to perform: "copy", "move", "delete", "mkdir", "exists", "info", or "find"

source.description: The source path to copy or move. You MUST specify the full path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/notes.txt') or absolute '/app/user_data/' path.

destination.description: The destination path for copy or move. You MUST specify the full path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/backup/notes.txt') or absolute '/app/user_data/' path.

path.description: Target path for delete, mkdir, exists, info, or find actions. You MUST specify the full path starting with 'user_data/' (e.g. 'user_data/documents') or absolute '/app/user_data/' path.

recursive.description: Whether to perform recursive copying, deleting, or scanning (defaults to true)

pattern.description: Wildcard pattern to search for, e.g., "*.txt", "*.png" (only applicable for "find" action)
